formats.key: dagSwapByOrderId(uint256 orderId, (uint256 fromToken, address toToken, uint256 fromTokenAmount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 deadLine) baseRequest, (address[] mixAdapters, address[] assetTo, uint256[] rawData, bytes[] extraData, uint256 fromToken)[] paths)
effects: Takes baseRequest.fromTokenAmount of fromToken from the signer (or that amount of ETH from msg.value when fromToken is ETH).
When the trailing calldata has a from-token commission, also takes up to about 3% more of fromToken (or ETH) from the signer and sends it to the referrers.
Sends at least minReturnAmount of toToken to the signer (msg.sender), after any to-token commission and trim are cut.
Any ETH sent above fromTokenAmount plus commission stays in the router.
formats.shown: Swap, with order ID, amount to send in fromToken, minimum to receive in toToken and deadline; recipient and ETH value not shown.

findings.title: dagSwapByOrderId: a from-token commission in trailing calldata takes extra tokens beyond Amount to Send.
findings.evidence: CommissionLib._getCommissionAndTrimInfo: `let commissionData := calldataload(sub(calldatasize(), 0x20))`; _doCommissionFromTokenInternal: `let amount := div(mul(inputAmount, rate), sub(DENOMINATOR, totalRate))` then `_claimToken(token, payer, referrer, amount)`. Descriptor shows only `baseRequest.fromTokenAmount` as 'Amount to Send'.
findings.fix: ERC-7730 cannot read the trailing commission bytes. Relabel the field 'Amount to Send (before fees, up to 3%)' and add an @.value field for the native case.

findings.title: dagSwapByOrderId is payable but has no @.value field, so the native value sent is not shown.
findings.evidence: DagRouter._dagSwapInternal: for ETH `IWETH(_WETH).deposit{value: _baseRequest.fromTokenAmount}()` with no check that msg.value equals it; native commission is paid from the router's ETH. The format has no `@.value` field.
findings.fix: Add {"path":"@.value","label":"Native amount sent","format":"amount"}.

findings.title: dagSwapByOrderId: the screen never says the output goes to the signer's own wallet.
findings.evidence: DexRouter.dagSwapByOrderId: `return dagSwapTo(orderId, msg.sender, baseRequest, paths);`. Case 0 reader: 'Which address receives the RAVE; screen doesn't say it is your wallet'.
findings.fix: Add a field on @.from labelled 'Recipient', or put 'to your wallet' in an interpolatedIntent.

cases.notes: 265.517876 USDC out matches. RAVE received (995.96) is above the 994.76 minimum. No commission in this tx. Reader did not know who receives the RAVE.

findings.title: dagSwapTo shows 12.817259 USDT sent, but a hidden dual commission took 12.855826 USDT.
findings.evidence: Case 1: signer USDT out 12817259 to the adapter plus 38567 to the router, split to 0xfa00… (7713) and 0xd64a… (30854); signerNet -12855826. Screen: 'Amount to Send 12.817259 USDT'. Calldata ends with flag 0x22220afc2aaa (FROM_TOKEN_COMMISSION_DUAL); CommissionLib._doCommissionFromTokenInternal `_claimToken(token, payer, referrer, amount)`.
findings.fix: ERC-7730 cannot read the trailing commission. Relabel 'Amount to Send (before fees, up to 3%)' and document the limitation.

findings.title: dagSwapTo is payable but has no @.value field for the native value sent.
findings.evidence: DagRouter._dagSwapInternal deposits `_baseRequest.fromTokenAmount` for ETH and never compares it with msg.value; the format has no `@.value` field.
findings.fix: Add {"path":"@.value","label":"Native amount sent","format":"amount"}.

findings.title: dagSwapTo: a zero receiver means the signer, but the screen shows the zero address.
findings.evidence: DexRouter.dagSwapTo: `receiver = receiver == address(0) ? msg.sender : receiver;`. The Beneficiary field has no senderAddress parameter.
findings.fix: Add "senderAddress": ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"] to the Beneficiary params.

cases.notes: USDT out merged is 12.855826 against 12.817259 shown, because of the hidden from-token commission. TSLAx received is above the minimum and goes to the beneficiary, who is the signer.

effects: When bit 255 of rawdata is clear: takes amount (low 128 bits) of ETH from msg.value and sends amount WETH to the signer.
When bit 255 is set: takes amount WETH from the signer through the approve proxy and sends ETH to the signer.
With a to-token commission in trailing calldata, the signer receives amount minus up to 3%.
With a from-token commission, the signer pays up to about 3% extra in the input asset.

findings.title: swapWrap: the amount uses the mainnet WETH constant on all 24 chains.
findings.evidence: Descriptor swapWrap field 'Amount': `"token": "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2"`; deployments include chains 10, 56, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114 and others, where the wrapped native token has another address.
findings.fix: Drop the token constant and show the amount with format 'amount' (native currency), or use a per-chain constant.

findings.title: swapWrap: the enum labels first byte 0x01 as WETH to ETH, but the code wraps ETH.
findings.evidence: DexRouter.swapWrap: `reversed := and(rawdata, _REVERSE_MASK)` with _REVERSE_MASK = 1<<255. Descriptor enum swapDirection: `"1": "WETH --> ETH"`; byte 0x01 has bit 255 clear, so the code runs ETH → WETH.
findings.fix: Remove key "1". Note that bytes 0x02-0x7f and 0x81-0xff have no label; ERC-7730 cannot test one bit, so document this.

findings.title: swapWrap: a hidden commission changes the amount received or sent, and no @.value field exists.
findings.evidence: DexRouter._swapWrap: `if (!commissionInfo.isFromTokenCommission) { require(msg.value == amount ...) }`, then `_doCommissionAndTrimToToken(...)` cuts the output. The descriptor shows one 'Amount' and no `@.value`.
findings.fix: Add {"path":"@.value","label":"Native amount sent","format":"amount"} and relabel Amount 'Amount (before fees)'.

findings.title: swapWrap: the amount slice takes 17 bytes but the code uses only the low 16 bytes.
findings.evidence: CommonUtils: `SWAP_AMOUNT = 0x…00ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff` (128 bits). Descriptor: `"path": "rawdata.[-17:]"`.
findings.fix: Change the path to "rawdata.[-16:]".

cases.notes: First byte 0x80 shows WETH --> ETH. 0.015264 WETH out and 0.015264 ETH in, matching the screen on mainnet. No commission.
